subject.title: Route org publisher abuse nominations to org review

question: Should organization publisher-abuse nominations be deliberately removed from automatic warning and account-ban enforcement and routed only to staff-managed org/member review?
rationale: The branch is mechanically coherent, but choosing whether an org nomination may trigger automatic enforcement, an organization suspension, or only a member-specific action is a moderation and authorization policy decision.

options.title: Approve the org-review boundary
options.body: Keep automatic bans restricted to identified user accounts and accept the proposed future-action lane as the required staff handoff for organization publishers.

options.title: Require automatic organization enforcement
options.body: Define and implement a separately authorized organization suspension or escalation path before moving org nominations out of automatic enforcement.

options.title: Defer the workflow
options.body: Leave current behavior unchanged until maintainers specify the permanent organization-abuse enforcement policy.

recommendation.title: Approve the org-review boundary
recommendation.body: Keep automatic bans restricted to identified user accounts and accept the proposed future-action lane as the required staff handoff for organization publishers.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the available recent contributor for the publisher-abuse workflow and can route the policy question to the appropriate repository decision-makers.
